Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the summary and the clear set of questions. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement preference: PO with net 45 is preferred. We typically avoid corporate card purchases for platform commitments.
- Marketplace interest: We are open to AWS Marketplace for procurement consolidation, but we need to confirm if listing supports our billing and cost center mapping. AWS Marketplace would be preferred if it does not add extra fees on our side.
- Required docs: security will want SOC2 Type II report (or attest summary), a network diagram, DPA, and a short data flow description.
- Procurement contact: procurement@sunrisefintech.com (Rahul is copied here and will coordinate).
- Timeline: aiming for contract sign by end of Q2, earlier if possible. Initial pilot PO expected within 6-8 weeks after paperwork is in place.

I attached a short procurement_requirements.xlsx that lists our standard fields for PO and vendor onboarding. Please review and let us know what you need from your side.

Thanks for the context. Quick pricing and ops notes below that we can share directly with Sunrise.

Pricing summary (high level):
- Direct invoice (PO): list price minus standard volume discounts. Billing via Redwood invoice, net 45 as requested. Typical lead time for invoiced agreements: 2-4 weeks after commercial signoff.
- AWS Marketplace: pricing needs to be listed on Marketplace; gross-to-net mechanics can introduce a ~3-5% delta depending on marketplace settlements. Marketplace consolidates billing which some customers prefer for chargeback.

Marketplace time-to-publish: typically 6-8 weeks from agreement on listing details and receiving required legal templates from the marketplace. This includes security attestation and billing setup.

Docs and links for Sunrise:
- We will provide: SOC2 summary, network diagram, DPA, and a short onboarding checklist.
- Marketplace onboarding checklist: redwood-marketplace-onboarding-checklist.pdf
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/67890123
- If they want to NDA before sharing full SOC2, use: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/marketplace-nda

Proposed next steps to share with Sunrise:
1) I will send a concise pricing comparison note and a DocuSign link for either a direct SOW or marketplace listing agreement.
2) Rishi to intro procurement@sunrisefintech.com to our procurement lead for PO template exchange.
3) Dev to upload SOC2 summary and network diagram to the secure drive link; we will only share after the NDA if they request one.

I can join a call with AWS Marketplace rep to accelerate listing logistics. Sergio, can you help coordinate dates next week for a quick sync?
